diagnostics.indicator_policy: absolute scalar propagation, mu=8*format epsilon; quad-to-LD conversion included
diagnostics.counter_semantics: query_successes means raw event batch completed, including subsequent score failure; numeric_failures may include that score guard
diagnostics.scalar_counter_scope: tracked value/indicator operations; not total machine floating-point instruction counts
diagnostics.memory_scope: tracked major native numerical containers only; excludes query bookkeeping, scalar stack temporaries, allocator overhead, caller buffers and Python selector/model/caches; not RSS or a complete allocator peak
diagnostics.state_policy: at most one current canonical Z state in each precision; no subset-factorization cache
diagnostics.auto_policy: one LD batch, at most one whole-prefix quad refinement on numerical failure; fixed R/E; no samples redrawn
diagnostics.arithmetic_environment: x87 extended precision / nearest; SSE nearest with FTZ and DAZ off; control fields restored
